column7: ADR-029 (signed checkpoint): "a chain shorter than the certified length ... flips valid to false". The offline verifier compares the authenticated checkpoint's signed chained_events (plus purged) with the chain it walked, and reports BROKEN when the signed count is higher, independently of the head-id, head-hash and high-water checks. The test signs a checkpoint with a count above a linked, hash-correct chain whose head and high-water mark are true; with the count check disabled the verdict is VALID. Scope: this row covers the count comparison only; tail truncation in practice is also caught by the head-missing check (covered elsewhere), so this is the claim that the signed count itself is enforced, not that every truncation path reaches it.
